answer: Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the karst is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the raven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
